name: Cecilee
description: Ruzi's sister, once a mute elf girl who became a voice of the Worldsoul, who founds a Selesnya settlement in the Rubblebelt and is killed by Massacre Girl.

description_citations.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
description_citations.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Mazena makes clear that Ruzi must find his sister Cecilee, and he cannot say no.
timeline.quote: You want me to find my sister.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi recalls Cecilee's departure for the Rubblebelt and her silence, and that she adopted a Gruul child named for him.
timeline.quote: He'd heard that she'd adopted an abandoned Gruul child to raise as her own.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and Kuma reach the edge of the Rubblebelt before dawn and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.
timeline.quote: Hours later, Ruzi and Kuma had reached the last roof at the edge of the Rubblebelt.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee, mute from childhood, suddenly speaks in a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya at Vitu-Ghazi, and the dryads call her a conduit to the Worldsoul.
timeline.quote: And then one day Cecilee did speak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Feeling called to establish a settlement in the Rubblebelt, Cecilee ignores Ruzi's warnings and leads twenty followers there.
timeline.quote: And so she went, leading twenty followers, to the wildest place any of them could imagine.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee adopts an abandoned infant with a Gruul tattoo and names him Ruzi, calling him Zi.
timeline.quote: Cecilee named the child after her brother, Ruzi, and took him into her home to raise as her own son.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: A Gruul shaman from Nikya's clan comes to take Zi back, but Cecilee refuses, and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
timeline.quote: After Cecilee adopted Zi, the Gruul sent a woman to take him back.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Before sunrise, an ogre breaks through the gate followed by Massacre Girl and her men, who are not Gruul.
timeline.quote: Just before sunrise, their gate flew off the hinges and splintered on the ground.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl strikes Cecilee and tears the young guild tree from the ground.
timeline.quote: The woman ripped the young guild tree out of the ground and hurled it across the courtyard

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl cuts off Cecilee's hair while Cecilee freezes.
timeline.quote: The woman took out her rusty blade and chopped the blonde hair from Cecilee's head.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee's followers lie dead, and Cecilee, mute again and cut off from the Worldsoul, has her throat cut.
timeline.quote: There was just the woman and her rusty blade cutting Cecilee's throat

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi gutted the first cultist to attack and is surrounded, weakened by the fear that Cecilee is among the dead.
timeline.quote: Cecilee's body would be among the dead, and that knowledge made Ruzi weak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister, without looking at her.
timeline.quote: he couldn't bear to look at his sister—not even as he placed her body into the mass grave

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

relations.quote: She explained that Nikya claimed the boy as kin and demanded he be raised as Gruul.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

relations.quote: My sister is dead, murdered in her home.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.
